name: notes_worklist
description: The Notes Worklist plugin provides a filterable worklist view of notes across their entire lifecycle — scheduled, in progress, finalized, and abandoned. Lets clinicians and ops staff filter by any subset of note states.

applications.name: Notes Worklist
applications.description: An Application that opens a filterable worklist view of notes across all states (pre-encounter, active, finalized, abandoned).

protocols.description: Provides api to fetch, filter, and sort notes by any subset of NoteStates.
